usage: Commonly used as a material noun: 銀 refers to the metal silver, and it often appears in everyday shopping, jewellery, and material descriptions.
In Cantonese, 銀 is also used in compound words like 銀器 and 銀飾; it sounds natural in both spoken and written language.
When talking about colour, 銀 can describe a silver shade, as in silver-looking objects, cars, clothes, or accessories.
Be careful not to mix it up with 港幣銀錢 in old-style or slangy contexts; in modern speech, 銀 usually means the metal or the colour.
